baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired قُلْ/قَالَ and the three سجد occurrences around إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One articulated saying calls for a bodily lowering; the collective performs it, while the exception answers with another saying and withholds the body. The interrogative reply converts a command-response event into a claim that the commanded act first requires the responder's valuation.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies both the effective command and the counter-speech that tries to suspend its effect.
Saying that functions like supposition, especially in a question, gives Iblis's reply the role of an asserted judgment rather than a request for information.
Lowering and submissive humility make the commanded response bodily and locate the exception in refused enactment.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a command, general obedience, and one disobedient exception.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages speech-act substitution: Iblis answers a performative command with an interrogative ranking judgment so that his own evaluation can stand between address and embodiment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقْتَ طِينًا in Iblis's reason for refusing سجود.
baseline_models.mechanism: The creation root supplies prior measuring and inventive making, whereas clay supplies mixed material. Iblis names the material result but suppresses the Creator's measuring act, reducing a formed creature to substrate and using that reduction as a rank test.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and apportioning make creation an intentional determination rather than an accidental material fact.
Inventive bringing-into-being supplies the agency that Iblis's material label backgrounds.
Mixed earth-and-water matter supplies the visible substrate that Iblis turns into a complete account of worth.

changed_reading.before: Clay simply identifies Adam's low material origin.
changed_reading.after: Clay is evidence selected by Iblis: his question erases measured making and treats one material predicate as if it exhausted the created being and fixed its rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation names Adam's honor over Iblis, and 17:70 expands honor, carrying, and preference to Adam's children while repeating creation. Rank is therefore enacted by the Creator's honoring and sustaining acts, not inferred upward from the creature's substrate.

activation_trace.role: Mixed clay is the material datum that Iblis wrongly makes decisive.
Noble honor names the non-material valuation that Iblis knows has been bestowed and resents.
Visible bearing supplies an enacted support of Adam's children rather than an abstract title.
Degree and excellence make preference an explicit ranking act that counters substrate-based rank.
The repeated creation field keeps divine making adjacent to, but distinct from, the preference granted among created beings.

structural_cues: 17:62 places كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ directly after the clay objection; 17:70 repeats كَرَّمْنَا and فَضَّلْنَاهُمْ around بَنِي آدَمَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit honor, carrying, preference, and repeated creation; I infer that the سجود command acknowledges this bestowed valuation. A live alternative is that the act tests obedience without specifying Adam's office.

changed_reading.before: Iblis disputes a rank supposedly readable from Adam's material composition.
changed_reading.after: Iblis rejects a rank he explicitly recognizes as bestowed; clay is not competing evidence but his attempt to replace the Giver's valuation with a material metric.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one figure who will not join the coordinated lowering immediately seeks people who will follow him, is told to mobilize whomever he can, and is followed later by a scene in which every people is called with its leader. The focus refusal is thus the opening move in a contest over alignment and followership.

activation_trace.role: Collective submissive lowering supplies the alignment from which Iblis visibly separates himself.
Loyal following and succession turn Iblis from an exception into a prospective center of alignment.
Noisy gathering and mobilization supply the operational means by which isolated refusal becomes a recruited formation.
A leader who is followed supplies the accountable endpoint of the passage's competing orientations.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from plural prostration and a singular exception, to مَن تَبِعَكَ, to mobilization, and finally to كُلَّ أُنَاسٍ بِإِمَامِهِمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exception, followers, mobilization, and leaders; I infer a social topology in which refusing one alignment founds another. The act may still be read more narrowly as obedience without a leadership relation.

changed_reading.before: Iblis's refusal is an isolated failure to obey.
changed_reading.after: The refusal is a bid to become an alternative pole of following: he will not enter the commanded formation and therefore tries to draw Adam's descendants into his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The servants in 17:65 are defined by submissive worship yet are precisely those over whom Iblis has no governing power, with a sufficient guardian standing for them. Directed submission to the divine command therefore functions as protection from rival domination rather than as degradation before Adam.

activation_trace.role: Submission and lowering supply the focus posture whose political effect the context clarifies.
Worshipful obedience identifies a directed servitude that does not transfer ownership to Iblis.
Power and governing authority name the rival relation explicitly denied over these servants.
One who sufficiently guards and conducts the affair supplies the protective governance paired with service.

structural_cues: The categorical لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ is followed by the sufficiency formula وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies service, denied authority, and sufficient guardianship; I infer that commanded lowering marks an anti-domination allegiance. Alternatively, 17:65 may describe protection without retrospectively defining the سجود's function.

changed_reading.before: Prostration appears to lower the obedient party beneath Adam.
changed_reading.after: Prostration places the obedient within a protected divine allegiance; Iblis's apparent refusal of subordination opens instead into his attempt to subordinate others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iblis immediately frames Adam as the demonstrable object whom God honored over him, so his seeing and ranking are coupled. The later doubled blindness, including blindness of insight, exposes the clay argument as selective sight: it sees substrate while screening out bestowed honor and formative agency.

activation_trace.role: Visible mixed matter supplies the feature on which Iblis fixes his valuation.
The attention-demanding and interrogative أَرَأَيْتَكَ makes Iblis present his ranking as something supposedly evident.
Honor supplies the acknowledged fact that his material gaze does not integrate.
Blindness of heart and insight names the epistemic failure latent in a materially accurate but normatively incomplete perception.

structural_cues: 17:62 joins أَرَأَيْتَكَ, the demonstrative هَذَا, and the relative clause ٱلَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ; 17:72 repeats أَعْمَى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Iblis's demonstrative seeing, his admission of honor, and later blindness; I infer that the focus question exemplifies selective perception. The blindness statement is general and need not refer only to Iblis.

changed_reading.before: The clay question offers a mistaken conclusion from a plainly seen fact.
changed_reading.after: The question performs blindness by selection: Iblis sees clay clearly but refuses to see creation and honor together, making partial visibility serve as total judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counter-speech in the focus grows into a rival discourse system: voice mobilizes, promises open false expectation, and deception supplies unstable appearance. Later pressure seeks to bend revealed content into an invented replacement. Refusal is therefore productive speech that tries to author another norm, not silence.

activation_trace.role: Articulated saying anchors both the received command and the first counter-utterance.
Audible voice expands private objection into a medium for moving others.
A spoken promise that opens hope supplies the forward pull of the rival discourse.
Deception by what glints but does not hold supplies the promise's unstable persuasive mechanism.
Divine disclosure supplies the received discourse that later pressure tries to displace.
Invented falsehood supplies the proposed counter-production of content.
Changing an image or substituting another thing supplies the replacement operation.

structural_cues: 17:64 coordinates voice, mobilization, promise, and deception; 17:73 coordinates revelation, fabrication, replacement, and resulting alliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two rival-discourse scenes; I infer a structural continuation from Iblis's reply to later human pressure on revelation. A live alternative is that 17:73 is an independent temptation pattern rather than direct extension of Iblis's agency.

changed_reading.before: Iblis voices a single objection to one command.
changed_reading.after: His reply is the seed-form of counter-authority: rival voice converts objection into promise, recruitment, and pressure to substitute authored content for received address.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus body's directed lowering contrasts with the later program of shaking people from stability, the divine act of fixing the addressee, and the danger of even slight leaning. A commanded descent can preserve orientation; refusal instead propagates agitation that tries to dislodge others.

activation_trace.role: Bending and lowering the head supply a chosen, directed change of bodily level.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies Iblis's contrary kinetic program.
Active strengthening and fixing supply the protection that keeps addressed response oriented.
Leaning and settling toward another supplies the small directional failure that stabilization prevents.
Repeated destabilization now aimed at removal from the land shows agitation becoming expulsive.

structural_cues: The imperative ٱسْتَفْزِزْ in 17:64 returns as يَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ in 17:76, with ثَبَّتْنَاكَ and تَرْكَنُ between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowering, repeated destabilization, fixing, and leaning; I infer that directed lowering and loss of stance are kinetic opposites. Alternatively, سجود may carry no stability claim beyond obedience.

changed_reading.before: Sajda is simply a loss of height, which makes refusal look like preservation of standing.
changed_reading.after: Sajda is controlled reorientation under command; Iblis preserves height only to become an agent of unsteadiness, while divine fixing prevents coerced leaning and expulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clay is packet-defined as mixed earth and water. The descendants are gently conveyed and explicitly carried across sea and dry land, yet can be swallowed by land or drowned by water. Adamic materiality thus names a mobile but dependent embodiment whose constituent domains can support or reclaim it under divine governance.

activation_trace.role: Earth-and-water mixture supplies the two-material anchor for the contextual land-sea system.
Gentle driving supplies governed motion through the water domain.
The earth's sinking and engulfment supply one form of elemental recapture.
Drowning in water supplies the complementary form of elemental recapture.
Being visibly borne supplies the sustaining action that prevents material vulnerability from fixing human rank.
Dry land supplies the earth-side domain across which Adam's children are carried.
Wide abundant water supplies the sea-side domain across which the same embodied descendants are carried.

structural_cues: The packet alternates sea and land danger in 17:66-69, then joins ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ under حَمَلْنَاهُمْ in 17:70.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clay as earth-water mixture and a land-sea sequence of carrying, sinking, and drowning; I supply the elemental arrow linking the mixture to those domains. The live alternative is ordinary travel-and-judgment imagery with no clay recall.

changed_reading.before: Clay is static, low matter and therefore a plausible mark of incapacity.
changed_reading.after: Clay condenses the passage's ecology of dependence: Adam's children traverse both sides of their mixed material origin only because they are borne, and either side can undo them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus has a compliant plurality with Iblis as the one exception. He then vows to seize Adam's dispersed descendants except a few, while the human scene in 17:67 ends in turning away and covering favor. The exception structure threatens to invert: the solitary refuser aims to make refusal the mass condition and obedience the remnant.

activation_trace.role: The repeated lowering supplies the initial compliant plurality against which one exception stands.
Tiny units spreading outward supply the multiplication of the conflict through Adam's descendants.
Fewness names the remnant Iblis projects outside his reach.
Turning one's side away supplies an Adamic recurrence of embodied refusal after rescue.
Covering a benefit supplies the perceptual-moral operation by which received favor is screened out.

structural_cues: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ in 17:61 is answered by إِلَّا قَلِيلًا in 17:62; the branchless لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ supplies the projected seizure connecting them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored exception constructions, descendants, fewness, and later human turning; I infer an inversion in the scale of refusal. The repeated إِلَّا may instead be local rhetoric without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The exception clause isolates Iblis and closes the prostration scene.
changed_reading.after: The exception clause opens a struggle over proportions: the one exception tries to reproduce his posture through Adam's line until those outside it are themselves only an exception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-primary fabricated-speech branch of خلق beside the ordinary creation sense. It remains anchored in خَلَقْتَ and gains context support from explicit revelation, fabrication, and substitution in 17:73. Downstream prose must present it only as a contrastive word-field activation, never translate خَلَقْتَ as lying or claim lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The creation root in خَلَقْتَ within Iblis's spoken challenge.

activation_trace.role: Fabricating speech supplies a distant counter-making image inside the same focus root whose primary action is divine creation.
Divine disclosure supplies the authoritative given content against which counter-making operates.
Invented falsehood makes fabricated discourse explicit in the context.
Substitution supplies the operation by which an alternative verbal product would replace received content.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts divine command with Iblis's opinion about a completed creation.
changed_reading.after: The focus also faintly activates a contest between divine making and counter-making in speech: the creature questions the made order, and the later pattern seeks to fabricate a verbal replacement for revealed order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the distant إسجاد-as-tribute branch rather than the primary prostration sense. It remains anchored in the repeated سجد forms and becomes functionally coherent when 17:64 joins participation with wealth and children. Render only as an economic-legal analogy of withheld recognition and illicit claim, not as a claim that the commanded سجود literally was taxation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three سجد forms in a command, compliance, and refusal sequence.

activation_trace.role: The tribute branch supplies a branch-distant image of recognition withheld from an ordered polity.
Participation and shared claim supply the reversal from refusing what is due to asserting a share in others' domains.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies the first domain of the illicit share.
Offspring from a lineage supply the second domain through which the claim reaches Adam's continuation.

changed_reading.before: Iblis refuses only a bodily sign of humility.
changed_reading.after: At the level of legal-economic analogy, he withholds ordered recognition and then seeks an unauthorized share in the wealth and lineage of the one he refused to recognize.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for focus ق و ل. It remains formally anchored by that supplied split mapping and by repeated literal قَلِيلًا in 17:62, 17:74, and 17:76. Downstream prose must call it a split-root resonance about shrinking remainders, never replace the ordinary meanings of قُلْ or قَالَ with fewness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's secondary ق ل ل target for the paired focus root ق و ل at word indices 2 and 9.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapped image of smallness makes the paired sayings a latent entry point into the passage's repeated shrinking remainders.
Literal fewness names the remnant Iblis expects not to seize.
A little leaning supplies a second narrowing around pressured alignment.
Only a little remaining supplies the final shrinking consequence around attempted expulsion.

changed_reading.before: The paired sayings merely frame the initial command and refusal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the sayings initiate a passage concerned with who is reduced to a few: the obedient remnant, a slight lean, or the brief remainder after expulsion.

strongest_changes: The clay argument becomes a deliberate substitution of material metric for known bestowed honor.
The lone refusal becomes an attempt to found an alternative following, while directed service blocks rival authority.
Iblis's counter-speech expands into voice, deceptive promise, and pressure toward fabricated replacement.
Clay's earth-water mixture becomes a figure of borne mobility and elemental dependence rather than fixed inferiority.
The exception pattern threatens to invert from one refuser among the obedient to a few obedient among captured descendants.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly converts static features in 17:61 into operations: honor is bestowed, bodies are aligned or destabilized, voices recruit, servants are protected, descendants are carried, and exception scales are reversed. The most distinctive latent activations were the land-sea ecology of clay and the tightly contained split-root and tribute analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The discourse link from Iblis's reply to the human pressure in 17:73 may be typological rather than a direct causal continuation.
The clay-to-land-and-sea mechanism depends on a reader-supplied elemental link, though both sides are packet-anchored.
The fabrication, tribute, and split-root outliers are branch-distant resonances and must not control lexical translation.
